metadata.case_name: LAI PO WAH v. CHAN WOON SUM AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: operating a scraper in a construction site
plaintiff.occupation_after: works for a flat letting agent

injuries.description: After two days the wound became gangrenous and the leg was amputated five inches below the knee.
source: After two days the wound became gangrenous and the leg was amputated five inches below the knee.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic amputation of lower leg

injuries.description: The left tibia and fibula were fractured.
source: The left tibia and fibula were fractured.

injuries.description: Exploratory surgery was carried out the same day shooing that all nevrovascular bundles were completely torn and thrombosed and all muscles were severed.
source: Exploratory surgery was carried out the same day shooing that all nevrovascular bundles were completely torn and thrombosed and all muscles were severed.

manifestations.description: near circumferential laceration, exposing fractured bone ends and tendons
there was no circulation to, or movement of, the toes
the distal lower limb was not viable
can walk for anything up to four hours
Martial Arts and football are no longer available to him
activities are inevitably going to be limited for the rest of his life

treatments_received: temporary immobilisation in a plaster cast
amputation five inches below the knee
transfer to the Rehabilitation Centre in Kwun Tong
prosthesis supplied and rehabilitation (learned to cope with his handicap)

losses.description: Amputation of the left lower leg five inches below the knee leading to permanent loss and lifelong limitation of activities.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Martial Arts and football are no longer available to him.

comparable_cases.injury_description: amputation above the knee in a man aged 22
plaintiff aged 59 and there was no amputation; prolonged and painful treatment for a wound which refused to heal
